o.text: Borrowed from Turkish elmas. Doublet of almaz.
Morphologically on iki + -inci. Cognate with Turkish on ikinci.
Ultimately from Arabic اِسْتِعْدَاد (istiʕdād), via Persian..
From Persian سورسات (sursât), perhaps ultimately a reborrowing from early Azerbaijani or another Turkic language.

From azadlıq + məhrum + etmə, literally “deprivation of freedom”.
Calque of Russian лише́ние свобо́ды (lišénije svobódy).
